Prior 0.2.0 (2026-06-01) adds a 5th contract clause â STEER: closes the cross-repo discoverability gap (handoff 623a9758, hexa-lang) where an agent hit the Agent-tool doc's `SendMessage` pointer (absent in this env) and TaskStop+relaunched to amend a sub-agent's scope. Implemented in hexa-lang (`_resilience_inject.hexa`, invoked via `hexa run`). On every Task/Agent spawn it emits a 5-clause verbatim contract: (1) BACKOFF â on rate-limit / 429 / 'overloaded' / throttle errors, do NOT abort, wait + retry with exponential backoff before treating as fatal; (2) CHECKPOINT â commit work in small logical units AS YOU GO (commit-early) so progress is durable, push when a unit completes; (3) RESUME â if restarted / re-dispatched, do NOT start over, inspect the last pushed commit and continue from there; (4) REPORT-ON-HALT â if you must stop before completion, report the last-good checkpoint (commit sha + what remains) so the parent can re-dispatch; (5) STEER â SendMessage is absent in this env, so do NOT TaskStop+relaunch to amend scope; run `/walkie on` early and the parent steers via `/walkie call <handle>` (sidecar walkie skill).
